◆ handle_scan_report_event()

bool dynamic_channel_selection_r2_task::handle_scan_report_event ( const sScanReportEvent &  scan_report_event)
private

Handle scan report events.

Parameters
scan_report_eventRefernce to sScanReportEvent object.
Returns
true if successful, false otherwise.

After a scan's report has been stored validated, need to clear the stored scan request handler. If the scan is a single scan, we can simply remove it from the radio's scan map. If the scan is a continuous scan, we need to check if the scan is still unabled. If the continuous scan is still enabled, we don't delete the scan request handler, but instead set the interval for its next iteration.
